workflows.title: Read-only cloud inventory
workflows.description: Review configured official cloud connections and resource inventory for meaningful changes.
workflows.instructions: Inspect only the configured targets using registered, read-only official cloud connections. Compare the current inventory with the previous successful run. Do not create or change cloud resources, start jobs, incur workload charges, or run arbitrary commands.

workflows.title: Virtual machine health
workflows.description: Check configured virtual machine health signals on a 15-minute cadence.
workflows.instructions: Inspect only configured virtual-machine targets and read-only health signals. Compare with the previous successful run. Do not start, stop, resize, or otherwise change any machine.

workflows.title: Stale-data watchdog
workflows.description: Check configured service signals for missing or stale observations; offset from the VM health cadence.
workflows.instructions: Inspect only configured service and data freshness targets using their read-only interfaces. Report missing or stale observations and compare with the previous successful run. Do not retry workloads or change service state.

workflows.title: Model catalog review
workflows.description: Review configured model catalog targets and highlight meaningful catalog changes.
workflows.instructions: Inspect configured model catalog targets through official read-only documentation or catalog tools. Compare the current result with the previous successful run. Do not download models, start jobs, or incur compute charges.

workflows.title: Repository issue changes
workflows.description: Review configured repository issue targets for changes and newly actionable items.
workflows.instructions: Inspect configured repository issue targets using read-only tools. Compare with the previous successful run and summarize only meaningful changes. Do not create, edit, close, or comment on issues.

workflows.title: Weekday workspace review
workflows.description: Review configured workspace signals each weekday and surface significant follow-up needs.
workflows.instructions: Review only configured workspace targets and their read-only status. Compare with the previous successful run and report important changes or unresolved issues. Do not edit files, start deployments, or send external messages.

workflows.title: Weekly repository security review
workflows.description: Review configured repositories for new security advisories and read-only source changes.
workflows.instructions: Review only configured repositories using read-only security and source metadata. Compare findings with the previous successful run. Do not open issues, modify source, install packages, or execute build/deployment jobs.
